Checked proper dual-cone sign, unrestricted-variable stationarity equality, exact dual objective, nonnegative gap pairing and qualified Slater statement.
Checked both requested derivations, every scalar/equality multiplier sign, free-variable effective-domain conditions, self-dual SOC pairing, explicit gap and correction of printed vector dimension.

Checked basis reduction including zero span, positive uniform eigenvalue bound on the sphere, coercivity/attainment at every auxiliary value including zero, auxiliary SDP Slater dual certificate and mutual exclusivity. Exact 2x2 counterexample and unattained zero value verified.
